reason: CLIN-SQL and SDE-SQL are no longer active; archived unchanged after validation v9.

evidence.cot_vs_official_release: gpt-5-mini validation, 178 common questions: adapted-judge SQL 0.389 vs released 0.433 (official judge); easy single-shot +0.016, gap concentrated in medium/hard incl. single-shot cases (no refinement) -> attributed to judge model (adapted gpt-5-mini vs official gpt-5-chat), not generation

settings.sde_sampling: grouped 3 requests x n=3 (= 9 samples, provider n limit)

GPT-5 adaptation: Responses API with explicit reasoning effort medium; temperature not sent (unsupported by reasoning models).
SDE-SQL self-consistency n=9 realised as 3 grouped requests with n=3 each.
Shared output cap 32768 tokens for every method (source sets none; bounds budget reservations).
BigQuery dialect/schema of MIMIC-IV v3.1 instead of the SQLite/BIRD setting of SDE-SQL.
Scoring: adapted rubric judge gpt-5-mini (medium) instead of Azure gpt-5-chat; Execution Score not computed (UNSCORED_DATA_EGRESS).
